title: Egyptian Wilted Kale Fondue
description: A unique and flavorful twist on traditional fondue, combining Egyptian spices with wilted kale. Serve as a snack or side dish.
instructions: Wrap the warm, wholesome, and wilted ingredients in foil and bake for 5 minutes to warm through.
In a large skillet, sauté the egyptian spice mix over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the kale to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the baked ingredients from the oven and chop into small pieces.
Add the chopped ingredients, wilted kale, and fondue cheese to the skillet.
Stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional egyptian spice mix if desired.
